components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default high-commitment action for participation, authentication, and flow completion.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 15px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #1455ee); border-radius: 10px; color: #fff; background: var(--blue, #1455ee); font: 690 13px/1.5 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-dark, #0d3eb8); border-color: var(--blue-dark, #0d3eb8); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1455ee); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action for account management, connecting identities, and secondary paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 15px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #cbd0d9); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink, #111318); background: var(--paper, #fff); font: 690 13px/1.5 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #9ea5b2; background: var(--soft, #f5f6f8); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1455ee); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact bordered field for searching projects, symbols, and allocation formats.
components.css: .ds-search { min-width: 250px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfe2e8); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--muted, #586171); background: var(--paper, #fff); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--blue, #1455ee); outline: 2px solid rgba(20, 85, 238, 0.12); } .ds-search svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--ink, #111318); background: transparent; font: 500 13px/1.5 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #667080; }
